answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 148699 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is Indian Cadbury chocolate halal or haram? They don't use any halal logo Question: Is Indian Cadbury chocolate halal or haram? They don't use any halal logo. Answer ID: 148699 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 599/505/SN=5/1438) We do not know what are the ingredients of these chocolates and what are the processes to prepare it. If you get the details from authentic sources and send us then we would consider it. However, it should be noted that mere rumor (for example it contains pig fat or any other haram and impure thing) cannot be termed haram according to Shariah. However, if someone avoids then it is good as it was said:. دع ما يريبك إلى ملا يريبك Translation: “Give up what is doubtful to you for that which is not doubtful”. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
